title: Rules with a home
sub: The map before the data, a series on enterprise architecture and why it matters for data: one rule found in five places and none of them its home; split at the wall into the network's rule and retail's, joined by what crosses; each with an owner and a reason; written in the business's words, about data objects in the domains that own them; attached to the step whose service level sets what to expect of the data; with its checks drawn from it, one way; and, written this way, generally an ontology.
howto: Paper on a wall is a draft, or a rule found somewhere; glass in the layers' colours is the confirmed model. Purple is motivation, where reasons and rules live; amber is strategy, where meter to cash and its stages are; yellow is the business layer, the work inside a stage; peach is information, where the data objects live. Blue is the network's side of the wall, rose is retail's. Cyan outlines the technical side, gold the business side.
